svg.title: A shortage forecast appears over a market whose stalls are still full.
svg.desc: Ordinary supplies fill the market baskets, but a steep red curve fed by welfare and flood-risk cards appears above the price slates. Buyers notice it and begin clustering.
svg.text: Page 38, panel 1 · Market establishing view as a shortage forecast appears above stocked stalls

text.tspan: The market engine predicts a shortage from linked
risk alerts even though current shelves remain

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
